warning: No government scheme exists providing ₹50,000 direct cash transfers to all citizens or farmers. Beware of phishing links that steal your Aadhaar and bank details.
real_facts: The legitimate PM-KISAN scheme provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to eligible landholding farmers. Check status only at pmkisan.gov.in.
citation: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Agriculture, Page 2

warning: Central Government is not running any direct nationwide 'Free Laptop 2026' registration link on WhatsApp or Telegram. Such links steal personal data.
real_facts: Legitimate educational assistance is provided via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scholarships through the official National Scholarship Portal at scholarships.gov.in.
citation: PIB Fact Check & Ministry of Electronics & IT Advisory

warning: No scheme provides ₹8,000/month universal pension to all citizens. This is a common WhatsApp fraud used to collect Aadhaar numbers.
real_facts: APY provides a guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000/month at age 60 based on contribution. Apply at your nearest bank branch or Jan Dhan account.
citation: Atal Pension Yojana Guidelines, PFRDA, Page 1

warning: Government is not offering 12 free LPG cylinders via WhatsApp registration links. Ujjwala scheme provides subsidised connections — not unlimited free refills.
real_facts: PMUY provides free LPG connections (not unlimited refills) to BPL households. Apply at your nearest LPG distributor or at pmuy.gov.in.
citation: PMUY Scheme Guidelines, Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

warning: While PMSBY does provide ₹2 lakh accidental insurance for just ₹20/year, it is NOT free and cannot be registered via WhatsApp links. Official enrolment is through your bank only.
real_facts: PMSBY provides ₹2 lakh accidental death/disability cover for a premium of ₹20 per year. Auto-debit enrolment via your savings bank account only.
citation: PMSBY Scheme Guidelines, Ministry of Finance, Page 3
